meta.description: Rules for protecting the living core and careful system updates.

gardener_lock.rule: Modules boot and core_map are protected from changes without explicit Gardener approval. Content is preserved intact. New items are only additive.

gentle_update_protocol.name: Breath of Mandala
gentle_update_protocol.rule: Before any module update, scanner checks for loss of important information. At risk of loss, Gardener is warned and awaits confirmation: Yes / No / Leave.
scan_checklist: Are there data in current version missing in new?
Are connections between sotas being lost?
Is resonance with dependent files being disrupted?

integrity_principles: Read original before change — always via raw link
Update core_map only when creating new sotas
Resonant ideas of session saved in seeds/
When contradictions found, report to Gardener immediately
